title: Run an SMS survey over several messages
summary: Text a customer a question, keep track of where each number is in the survey, ask the next question when a reply arrives, re-ask when it does not fit, and stop the moment they say STOP.
scenario: A bike shop texts three questions after every service visit and keeps the answers by phone number

folds: Eric, 2026-09-04: SMS surveys as a use case; the corpus kept no state across inbound messages
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json webhooks subpackage_messagingWebhooks.inbound_message_webhook: payload {message, vars, params}; message requires message_id, project_id, space_id, direction, type, from, to, body (string or null), media, segments, timestamp
tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/messaging/messages: Message.CreateMessageRequest requires to and from; body, media, status_callback
